posts.hook: Blurry notes are not your enemy
posts.title: Turn photos of scattered notes into one study guide
posts.payoff: Deciphering shaky handwriting is now optional.
moves: Snap clear photos of your notes (yours or a comrade's).
Upload all the images to an AI like Gemini or ChatGPT.
Ask: 'Combine into one summary with key terms and 10 quiz questions.'
Screenshot the summary and send it to your class group.
posts.caption:
AI Hack: messy notes into one clean study guide, in minutes. Save this before the next CAT catches you unprepared.

#AIHack #JuaKesho

critic.note: The AI-notes hack is common advice; sharpen with a more specific Kenyan pain point (e.g., exam CAT tomorrow) to feel less generic.

posts.claim: Football clubs only use AI for highlight reels and nothing else.
posts.real: Clubs also lean on AI and data analytics for scouting, tactics and injury prevention, the same stats behind matches like Chelsea vs Arsenal in the WSL.

posts.caption:

posts.title: The 'Pay To Get Paid' Loan Trick
posts.sms: Congratulations! You qualify for KES 50,000. Pay KES 1,500 activation fee to receive funds today.
tips: A real lender never asks for money before disbursing a loan.
Check if the lender is licensed on the CBK digital lenders list.
Report the number to your telco and block it immediately.
posts.caption:
Usiibiwe! If a 'loan' asks you to pay first, it's not a loan, it's bait. Send this to the comrade waiting on hustle capital.

#Usiibiwe #JuaKesho

warnings: states facts but has no `source`; verify before approving

critic.note: Solid and useful, but the loan-scam warning format is common—add a fresh twist like a real recent scam number or platform name.

scripts.radio: Sasa Wanakesho! Jua hapa, na leo tuko na mambo mazuri. Kwanza, kama uko campus na notes zimetapakaa kila mahali, unaweza piga picha na uambie AI ikusanye kwa summary moja, na hata iku-tengenezee maswali ya mtihani. Dakika tano, umemaliza. Pili, tunataka kuwaonya kuhusu hii mchezo mpya wa loan apps. Wanakutumia ujumbe wanasema umeidhinishwa loan ya elfu hamsini, lakini kwanza ulipe elfu moja na mia tano 'activation fee'. Hiyo ni wizi. Loan halisi haikuombi pesa kabla ya kukupa pesa. Kama umepata ujumbe kama huo, block na ripoti. Tatu, tumewaonyesha M-KOPA, kampuni ya Kikenya inayotumia AI kuwapa watu solar na simu bila collateral, wanalipa kidogo kidogo. Hii ni mfano wa jinsi teknolojia inavyosaidia watu wa kawaida. Mwisho, tumeangalia campus ya kesho, AI itakuwa inasaidia na assignments, vyeti vitakuwa digital, na hata attendance itakuwa rahisi na QR code. Kesho iko hapa, tuko tayari? Kwa Kiswahili: tunazungumzia hila za AI shuleni, wizi wa loan apps, kampuni ya M-KOPA, na mabadiliko yanayokuja chuo kikuu. Fuata Jua Kesho kwa zaidi.
scripts.voice_note: Eh, wewe. Nataka tu nikuambie mambo mbili haraka haraka. Moja, kama uko na notes za campus zimetapakaa, chukua tu picha zote uzipeleke kwa AI, uiambie ikutengenezee summary na maswali ya kujitest. Inasave muda sana, jaribu leo. Pili, kuna hii trick mpya ya loan apps, wanakutumia wanasema umeidhinishwa loan, lakini kwanza ulipe fee ndio upewe pesa. Hiyo ni wizi wazi, block hiyo number. Sawa? Share hii voice note na wale watu wako group, wasidanganywe. Kesho iko hapa, tulinde kila mmoja.
scripts.sms: Usiibiwe! Loan 'halali' haikuombi pesa kwanza. Ukipokea ujumbe ukiambiwa ulipe 'activation fee' kupata loan, ni wizi. Block na ripoti mara moja.
scripts.reels: Campus ya kesho inakuja haraka. Hakuna tena kungoja saa nne kwa office ya lecturer, AI itakusaidia papo hapo. Vyeti vyako vitakuwa online, hakuna tena kuogopa kupoteza karatasi. Attendance ya kujisainia mwenyewe, itakuwa historia, QR code inaingia. Practical bila kungoja microscope moja, virtual labs zinakuja. Na internship, badala ya kutuma application mia moja, AI itakulinganisha na kazi inayokufaa. Kesho iko hapa, umejiandaa?
